headline: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
body: The Company will be participating in the analyst/institutional investor conferences/meetings on 18th and 19th November 2026 as per enclosed schedule.

headline: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Directorate
body: This is to inform you that the shareholders of the Company have today, i.e. 6th November 2026 approved the appointment of Mr. Leo Puri as an Independent Director of the Company. Mr. Leo Puri shall assume office as Chairman of the Board with effect from 23rd January 2027, upon completion of the term of Mr. R. Seshasayee as Chairman and Independent Director on 22nd January 2027.

headline: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Date of payment of Dividend
body:
The Board of Directors at its meeting held today has approved the payment of interim dividend of Rs. 5.75 per equity share for the financial year ending 31st March 2027.

The dividend will be paid to the shareholders on or after 13th November 2026.
